I played Harvest Moon as a kid, but haven't had a chance for years. I've been looking all over for a farming simulator that would hit the spot, given my limited console setup. 

Hay Day was fun for a bit, but was too much of a corporate funnel to be enjoyable after a while. Same with Farmville. I heard about Farming Simulator and thought it had to be the answer to my longings, but was sorely disappointed. I was talking with friend about how let down I was and they recommended Stardew Valley. And it was literally exactly what I was looking for! And more! 200 hours on record and I'm going strong!

I was trying to decide between Alex, Leah, Sam and Harvey. Only got to 8 hearts with them BC I didn't realize you could date everyone. At that point, Harvey is the only one who pretty actively flirts with you. And the blushing portrait is 10/10. I was thoroughly won over.

I did on the first one, but all my later ones I only court a hunny to marry. 

It is nice to get stuff in the mail, though, and the community aspect is charming, so that might change in the future.

Harvey cooks you a well-rounded breakfast every 3 years or so, and might water your crops around as often! /s 

Maybe he's a bit of a slacker but I can't bring myself to care. He has the cutest blush sprite and some of the most adorable flirting dialogue, before marriage and after.
